dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins appear relatively smooth and symmetrical with no localized bulges or indentations visible against the water interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium-grey median pixel intensity, indicating a non-mature developmental stage.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse, low-frequency darker grey mottling distributed across the dorsal surface, with higher density clusters near the lateral margins.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the lighter dorsal canvas and darker mottled regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A prominent, high-contrast white longitudinal linear mark situated on the central dorsal ridge, with a smaller punctate white mark located posterior to it.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, elongated white scar along the central dorsal axis and a smaller circular white mark posterior to the main lesion.
